contract: GET /api/feeds. Admin feed listing: a feeds array of full client feed objects (id, slug, userId, entityType, entityId, entityUpdatedAt, coverPath, meta, serverAddress, feedUrl, episodes, createdAt, updatedAt) and a minified array with the id/entityType/entityId/feedUrl/meta subset, both index-aligned and covering every persisted feed including feeds opened after startup. 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin.
exceptions: Array order is not asserted (only that feeds[] and minified[] are index-aligned): the config page maps the arrays and sorts episodes for display (client/pages/config/rss-feeds.vue:140-146).

Unexecuted upstream helper: RssFeedManager.findFeedForEntityId (L59-65) is called by item/series detail projections (LibraryItemController.js:82, SeriesController.js:57, LibraryController.js:800), not by GET /api/feeds; those projections belong to the item_read/browse records.

invariants.contract: GET /api/feeds as root returns one feeds[] entry and one index-aligned minified[] entry per persisted feed with the full client shape: id, slug, userId (feed owner), entityType, entityId, entityUpdatedAt (millisecond timestamp of the newest source entity), coverPath (string or null), meta{title, description (string or null), author, imageUrl, feedUrl, link, explicit, type, language (string or null), preventIndexing, ownerName, ownerEmail}, serverAddress, feedUrl, episodes[] with id/title/description/enclosure{url,size,type}/pubDate/link/author/explicit/duration/season/episode/episodeType/fullPath and createdAt/updatedAt millisecond timestamps. opened feeds appear with their persisted values; a non-admin gets 403 and an anonymous caller 401 without feed data.
